YNot1989 wrote:
I appreciate your proposal. But 2160 is the current cutoff date. If I decide to extend it, I'd be happy to include your idea.

Now, I am open to changing the order of succession of Presidents (though some are set in stone. Carla Anderson, Tom Steele, Evalyn Jacobi, Lionel Halvidar, Oscar Lachman, the big ones basically) however it is worth noting that the formation of the office, only one British Prime minister has ever been assassinated, Spencer Perceval in 1821, almost 200 years ago. So its not that odd for so much time to pass without an assassination of a head of state.

Alright, thank you. Would i be able to contribute to the lore of the page (Teporis') if it's ever created?

And btw, I was thinking of a few ideas to change several presidents, but I think most of them are already set in stone so maybe not rn


thx for the reply and info
